name: Doug Fiefia
stance: Sponsored HB 286 requiring large AI developers to assess catastrophic risks, publish safety plans and report incidents; says safety and innovation can coexist.

statements.text: Sponsored HB 286, requiring large AI companies to assess catastrophic risks and harms to minors, post safety plans and report safety incidents to Utah's AI policy office; it stalled in the House after a White House memo opposed it.
I think there's a way to thread that needle.
